state_contract: Host config and catalog_path; pause, identity, receipt and source-hash protections unchanged
import_side_effects: No new service/browser/model starts; capabilities preserve their original explicit call side effects
compatibility: New projects use canonical packages and public APIs; existing resident entries are served only by pipeline adapters

web__serve.signature: serve(config, config_path, port, open_browser, *, background=False, access_token=None)

side_effects: 本机HTTP服务、访问凭据和用户明确执行的操作；读取和写入语义独立。
selection_and_retention: 选独立后台HTTP服务和读取有限重试，关闭终端不影响远程查阅；写请求回执不明不重试。保留KaTeX/Marked及许可证供科学文字与公式显示，页面不改科学正文。
runtime_activation: No automatic start/resume; existing controls and sole owner remain authoritative

POST /api/reveal-local.output: 200 {ok:true}; missing file 404; invalid input or non-macOS 400
POST /api/reveal-local.side_effect: Reveal catalog original file (fallback card) in server Mac Finder; open -R, timeout 10s; no automatic retry

POST /api/literature-level2/control.side_effect: Independent verified-original L2 worker only, exact-source release required. Does not control L1 or original workflows.

passwordless_access.config: workbench_passwordless defaults to false. Production uses loopback or the configured private Tailscale Serve route with a user identity header.
passwordless_access.writes: Passwordless POST requires a single exact same-origin Origin. Legacy token mode remains available for configurations that omit the option.
passwordless_access.launcher: Prints plain URLs in passwordless mode. Workbench listener binds only to 127.0.0.1.

literature_routes.access: Workbench Host and access mode guards; same-origin POST in passwordless mode; write conflicts 409; no workflow control
literature_routes.core_labels: List badges show core labels only; details retain supporting evidence and inherited parents; tag filters use core + inherited. paper-literature==0.6.0

manual_seed_three_candidates.scope: explicit five-root source-hash list and authorization SHA
manual_seed_three_candidates.selection: highest real full-source passing review >=85, no missing/major/critical or unapplied correction; otherwise existing repair
manual_seed_three_candidates.preservation: original cards/reports/receipts/retry counts, pauses and unknowns; no old answers in generation
manual_seed_three_candidates.progress: cards.seed_trials.status; independent priority label, never sentinel numeric quality

manual_seed_cards.list: Authenticated GET /api/state?tab=manual_seed_cards uses existing search, pagination and card ranking for registered manual roots with original-bound cards. Each row includes manual_seed_card {kind, status, sha256}.
manual_seed_cards.card: Authenticated GET /api/card?id=... accepts optional sha256 to pin the displayed card bytes and returns 409 if that version changed.

literature_level2_status: GET /api/state includes read-only literature_level2 in ETag; own registered toolbar
